scripts.setup: python -m venv backend\.venv && backend\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt && npm install --prefix dashboard
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn homenet.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix dashboard"
